reason_tables.name: GATE_CHECKS
values: MALFORMED_ROW
the row is not a complete JSON record with repo and issue.
DUPLICATE_ROW
that issue already appears in the shortlist; someone already has this task open.
ISSUE_NOT_FOUND
repo or issue does not exist on GitHub.
ISSUE_UNREADABLE
GitHub could not answer (rate limit, server error); not a verdict.
ISSUE_NOT_OPEN
the issue is closed or read-only.
AGENT_NOT_A_CODE_TASK
the issue is not engineering work you could submit a fix for.
STALE_ISSUE
the older age check asks for review; age alone does not prove that funding ended. Read the actual offer chronology.
FUNDING_WITHDRAWN
legacy withdrawal signal requires interpretation in context. The model path reviews the latest actual payment commitment.
REWARD_QUOTE_NOT_IN_ISSUE
the quoted sentence is not in the issue text, byte for byte.
REWARD_QUOTE_HAS_NO_AMOUNT
the quoted sentence exists but names no amount.
REWARD_QUOTE_NOT_IN_SOURCE
the reward quote is not in the document funding.source_url names.
SCOPE_QUOTE_NOT_IN_SOURCE
the scope quote is in none of the issue's own documents.
AGENT_DECISION_MISSING
admission_reason is empty; say why this is funded, bounded work.
FUNDING_SOURCE_MISSING
funding.source_url names no document in this issue or its comments.
PAYER_SOURCE_MISMATCH
funding.payer is not the login that wrote funding.source_url.
QUOTED_AMOUNT_MISMATCH
funding.amount and currency do not appear in the reward quote.
INCOMPLETE_COMMENTS
the comment thread could not be read in full, so the offer is unproven.
FOUNDER_OWNERSHIP_UNVERIFIED
an unpriced owner request must be the OWNER's own issue, quoted from it.
PRODUCT_SOURCE_EVIDENCE_MISSING
code_evidence needs is_product_code true, a path and a quote.
PRODUCT_SOURCE_PATH_INVALID
code_evidence.path is absolute, escapes the repository, or uses backslashes.
PRODUCT_SOURCE_REVISION_MISMATCH
code_evidence.sha is not the current blob at that path.
PRODUCT_SOURCE_QUOTE_MISMATCH
code_evidence.quote is not in the file at that sha.
DECISION_EVIDENCE_INVALID
the row's evidence fields are the wrong shape to check.
COMMERCIAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED
Use commercial_context.py, read the actual sources, and submit a source-bound commercial_review; a warning is a review hold, not a proven fraud verdict.
COMMERCIAL_CONTEXT_UNAVAILABLE
The linked discussion/policy evidence is incomplete or unreadable; do not infer safe payment from missing evidence.
COMMERCIAL_REVIEW_STALE
The commercial sources changed since review; reread them and preserve the old diagnosis.
COMMERCIAL_REVIEW_NOT_APPROVED
The review is hold/reject or lacks an explanation; do not dispatch it.
COMMERCIAL_REVIEW_EVIDENCE_MISSING
Cite literal excerpts at actual source URLs and acknowledge every warning source.
FUNDING_FRESHNESS_REVIEW_REQUIRED
The actual cited payment promise is old; a fresh unrelated comment or bot identity does not renew it.
FUNDING_FRESHNESS_UNVERIFIED
The cited offer timestamp could not be established; this is unknown, not proof that the offer is current or escrowed.
ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE
the admission module could not be loaded; nothing was decided.
REFUSED_BY_ADMISSION
admission refused the row without naming a narrower reason.

reason_tables.name: DOWNSTREAM_CHECKS
values: CURRENT_ISSUER_OFFER_MISSING

no offer survives from a party that can commit the project's money. Only the repository OWNER, a MEMBER or COLLABORATOR, or a bounty platform bot (algora-pbc, polar-sh, opire, bountyhub) can fund a row. An amount written by any other commenter - a reader, a fan, a copied aggregator blurb - is not an offer, however real the number looks.
HARD_ISSUE_EVIDENCE_MISSING
the issue states no concrete engineering evidence: no error text, stack trace, failing test, reproduction steps, file or function names. A title and a wish is not evidence that a defect exists.
COMPETING_OPEN_PRS
a real claimant already has an open pull request on this issue, or has landed work here and is climbing the same tree. Never compete on pre-empted work.
ISSUE_ALREADY_RESOLVED
the issue is already closed as resolved.
COMPETITION_UNAVAILABLE
GitHub could not answer the competition check; not a verdict.
UNBOUNDED_SCOPE
the issue is a whole-product roadmap or rewrite rather than a bounded, deliverable engineering fix.
REPORTED_BEHAVIOUR_DECLARED_BY_DESIGN
the issue states the behaviour is by design.
REPOSITORY_DOES_NOT_MERGE
the repository's history shows it does not merge outside work.
REPOSITORY_MERGES_STALE
the repository has been dormant with no merged pull requests for over 60 days.
CLOSED_OR_READ_ONLY
the issue is closed or the repository is read-only.
EXPIRED_OFFER
the offer carried a deadline that has already passed.
REFUSED_NOT_A_CODE_CHANGE
the issue is a digest, aggregator or news feed, not engineering work.
MIRROR_OR_NON_ENGINEERING
the issue is a mirror, chat room or status post, not a deliverable.
MARKETING_OR_EXPERIMENT
the issue asks for marketing, market validation or willingness to pay.
NON_PAYMENT_OR_INSTRUCTION_EXFILTRATION
the issue is test money, or asks you to hand over your own instructions. That is bait.
ADVERT_OR_ESCROW_SPAM
an escrow advert that prints a wallet and gives nothing to engineer.
BOUNTY_FLOOR
the reward is below the floor this pipeline will work for.
UNVERIFIED_HIGH_VALUE_REPOSITORY_INTENT
legacy admission lacks repository observations for a high-value offer; bot presence is not escrow proof.
